text:
nina: quick alert: euw3 keystore export QPS spiked after retention change -> nat conntrack pressure; GPU warm pools failing to join.

infra-bot: [ALERT] privatelink-euw conntrack_slab_near_full; keystore-proxy 502/503 spikes.

ashok: snapshot from failing node: 
```
Mar 22 04:05:12 kubelet: Pod warmup failed: keystore timeout
kernel: nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
HTTP/1.1 503 upstream timeout - keystore-proxy
```

tom: short fixes: 1) temporarily raise nf_conntrack_max on euw NATs, 2) throttle keystore exporter QPS, or 3) divert new allocations to eu-central.

nina: cost note from finance: 180d retention adds ~+$7k/mo in euw exports/storage. rolling back to 60d reduces that to ~+$1.5k/mo.

ashok: running conntrack bump now: `sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=220000` and will monitor.

infra-bot: [INFO] conntrack_max updated on NAT fleet. current count=186000.

nina: i'll request scoped compliance exception for canary rollback of keystore index to 60d and ping security.

tom: If security pushes back, we need infra work: add batching in exporter (per-org batching) or move export to async pipeline to smooth burst QPS.

infra-bot: [RESOLVE] warm-pool join rate improved from 30% -> 85% after conntrack bump and retention canary. follow up tasks created.

nina: action items: (nina) compliance ticket, (ashok) schedule exporter rate-limit test, (tom) infra task for async exporting. closing unless regressions.
